title: Kids story - Samuel Hears a Voice

parts.style: warm, gentle bedtime welcome, a soft smile in the voice, speaking slowly
parts.text: Hello, little one. <short pause> Are you all tucked in? <short pause> Pull your blanket up nice and snug... <short pause> because tonight's story is about a boy named Samuel, and a voice he heard in the night.

A long, long time ago, there was a boy named Samuel. <short pause> Samuel did not live in a house like yours. <short pause> He lived in a big, quiet tent called the house of the Lord, where people came to pray.

Samuel lived there with an old priest named Eli. <short pause> Eli was very old, with a long white beard, and his eyes could not see very well anymore. <short pause> So Samuel helped him. <short pause> He swept the floors. <short pause> He fetched the water. <short pause> And every evening, he helped to keep the golden lamp burning.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: One night, the lamp was glowing softly, and everything was quiet. <short pause> Eli was asleep in his room. <short pause> And Samuel was lying down on his little bed, his eyes growing heavy... <short pause> just like yours.
Then, in the stillness, Samuel heard a voice. <short pause> Samuel. <short pause> Samuel.

parts.style: tender, quiet storytelling, a soft smile in the voice
parts.text: Samuel jumped up and ran to Eli. <short pause> Here I am! <short pause> You called me. <short pause> But Eli rubbed his sleepy eyes and said, I did not call you, Samuel. <short pause> Go back and lie down.

So Samuel went back to his bed and pulled up his blanket. <short pause> But soon, he heard the voice again. <short pause> Samuel. <short pause> And again he ran to Eli. <short pause> Here I am! <short pause> And again Eli said, I did not call you. <short pause> Go back to sleep.

Then it happened a third time. <short pause> Samuel. <short pause> And this time, when Samuel came to him, old Eli sat up slowly. <short pause> He thought for a long moment. <short pause> And then he understood.
Samuel, said Eli gently, I think it is God who is calling you. <short pause> Go and lie down. <short pause> And if you hear the voice again, say this: Speak, Lord, for your servant is listening.

parts.style: gentle, slow, painting a calm scene
parts.text: So Samuel went back to his little bed. <short pause> He lay very, very still. <short pause> The lamp glowed. <short pause> The night was quiet. <short pause> And then he heard it, softly, one more time. <short pause> Samuel. <short pause> Samuel.

parts.style: slow, reflective, letting the words sink in
parts.text: And Samuel whispered, Speak; for thy servant heareth. <long pause>
And God spoke to Samuel that night. <short pause> Samuel was only a boy, but God knew his name. <short pause> And from that night on, Samuel listened for God's voice, all the days of his life.

parts.style: tender, intimate, very soft, speaking slowly
parts.text: Do you know what, little one? <short pause> God knows your name too. <short pause> He knows when you are happy, and when you are sad, and when you are snuggled up in bed like you are right now. <short pause> And He is always near.

Let's say a little prayer together. <short pause> Dear God, <short pause> thank You that You know my name. <short pause> Help me to listen to You, just like Samuel. <short pause> Please keep me safe tonight, and everyone I love. <short pause> Amen.
Now close your eyes. <short pause> The lamp is glowing. <short pause> The night is quiet. <short pause> And you are loved. <short pause> Goodnight, little one. <short pause> Sleep tight.
